items.title: Stablecoins Won't Scale Without Banks
items.summary: With a growing number of institutions exploring stablecoins, the bottleneck is regulated infrastructure they can trust.

items.title: This Crypto Project Just Funded 1,000 Student Loans Entirely On-Chain
items.summary: The team behind Pencil Finance says the financing supported thousands of Southeast Asian students, but it did not disclose borrower costs, defaults, or investor returns.

items.title: Ancient Bitcoin Wallet That Turned $120 Into $3 Million Wakes Up
items.summary: At least four more decade-old wallets moved a combined $15.7 million between Aug. 29 and Sept. 4, with one batch of coins sent to Coinbase in a likely sign of a sale.

items.title: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins
items.summary: Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum layer-2 network built with Arbitrum technology for tokenized assets, crypto apps, and on-chain financial products.

items.title: G7 Warns Quantum Threat Demands Action as Crypto Industry Weighs Fixes
items.summary: The group is urging organizations to adopt post-quantum security before powerful computers can compromise today’s encryption and digital signatures.

items.title: Polymarket Launches Crypto Perpetual Futures With Up to 20x Leverage
items.summary: The prediction market platform's new Perps product scaled from 10 markets to 67 on its first day—though the 20x leverage ceiling only applies to some of them, and none of it reaches U.S. traders.

items.title: Crypto Traders Are Pairing Meme Coins With Stocks on Robinhood—And It's Working (Sort Of)
items.summary: A meme coin called BONER cornered half of Hims & Hers Health's tokenized shares on Robinhood's new blockchain. It started a new trend that's spreading fast.

items.title: 'Send Your Lawyers': Robinhood Isn't Backing Down From AMC Over Stock Tokens
items.summary: Lawyers question AMC’s grounds for a securities-law challenge, but say the tokens’ branding and marketing could leave room for a dispute.

items.title: A16z-Backed OpenReserve Gets Approval for Full-Service National Bank
items.summary: The a16z-backed startup chose a full national charter over the trust-bank route most crypto firms have taken, clearing a path toward insured deposits and conventional lending alongside stablecoin issuance.

items.title: Zcash Hits Highest Price in Nearly a Decade, Crushing Short Bets
items.summary: The privacy coin's squeeze rode a Fed-driven crypto rally that reversed hours later, when a stronger-than-expected jobs report sent Bitcoin back under $80,000.

items.title: Bitcoin Slides as Blowout Jobs Report Revives Fed Hike Odds
items.summary: The Dow dropped 226 points and Bitcoin erased some of its gains after August payrolls tripled estimates, pushing September rate-hike odds to 58%.

items.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Stages Major Rally on Rate Hopes
items.summary: Bitcoin soared past $81k, HYPE and ZEC hit smashing new ATHs and the onchain rally leveled up. Is this the first stage of the next leg up?

items.title: IMF Now Says Donations Funded El Salvador's Bitcoin Growth
items.summary: A year ago the fund claimed the total had not moved, and that the reserve was only shuffling coins between government wallets.

items.title: Mexican National Pleads Guilty to Laundering More than $4M in Drug Trafficking Proceeds
items.summary: A Mexican national, Carlos Erick Vazquez Gonzalez, 48, pleaded guilty today for his role in the laundering of approximately $4 million in drug trafficking proceeds in the United States and the return of those proceeds via cryptocurrency to Mexico as part of a money laundering con

items.title: FinCEN Ties $12.7B to Crypto Scams Run From Asian Compounds
items.summary: Monthly reported sums rose 18% on average, and the compounds now appear to be spreading beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: AMC CEO Calls Robinhood Stock Tokens 'Contemptible' and 'Vile'
items.summary: Adam Aron says AMC Entertainment has no connection to the tokens and is putting outside securities counsel on the case.

items.title: Bitcoin Miner Ditches Site for AI Deal That Could Top $1.2 Billion
items.summary: The projected revenue requires two contract extensions, while an option for more computing capacity could bring the total above $3 billion.

items.title: What Is Pons? The Robinhood Chain Meme Coin Factory Token Up 18,000% Since July
items.summary: PONS, the token behind Robinhood Chain's biggest meme coin factory, flipped CASHCAT to become the chain's largest cryptocurrency by market cap—and its chart looks like a hockey stick.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Rebound as Ethereum and XRP ETFs End Winning Streaks
items.summary: Ethereum funds broke a 12-day winning run and XRP snapped an 11-session streak on Wednesday, while Bitcoin ETFs bounced back with $101.15 million in one day after their worst outflow since July.

items.title: CFTC Asks Judge to Dismiss CME Lawsuit Over Crypto Perpetual Futures
items.summary: The regulator argues that CME cannot challenge its approval of Kalshi’s Bitcoin perpetual contract without showing concrete financial harm.

items.title: Bitcoin Pumps as Fed Signals Rate Pause, $415 Million in Shorts Get Rekt
items.summary: Stocks and crypto rallied together after Governor Christopher Waller said he could back holding rates steady, with short sellers absorbing the brunt of the squeeze.

items.title: SoFi Links Banking Network and Stablecoin to Kraken in New Deal
items.summary: Kraken will list SoFiUSD and gain access to SoFi’s round-the-clock dollar settlement network, while Kraken Prime will execute trades for SoFi’s crypto customers.

items.title: Morning Minute: Strategy CEO Says Selling The Bottom Was Correct Move
items.summary: Strategy sold millions in Bitcoin in the low $60k range and just rebought at $80k. Now they’re sharing the rationale behind the moves.

items.title: Ukraine Busts Kyiv Crypto Drainer Ring Moving Up to $1M Monthly
items.summary: Fake investment ads on Telegram channels funneled EU victims to a lookalike exchange that emptied their wallets.

items.title: Justice Department Continues to Disrupt Hamas Terrorist Financing Schemes Through Seizures of Cryptocurrency and Internet Infrastructure
items.summary: Today the Justice Department announced the disruption of an ongoing scheme by Harakat al-Muqawama al-Islamiyya (Hamas) –— a designated Foreign Terrorist Organization — to raise funds for terrorist operations and recruit supporters.
